Priyom / Lauren — attached is a draft discount waterfall and an implementation note. TL;DR recommendation:

1) Convert unused vouchers to a one-time invoice credit on OrbitForge’s first paid invoice (clear ledger entry).
2) Implement retroactive tiering for the first billing month post-conversion (if they hit a higher tier we apply the higher % across that month).
3) For months 2-3, apply incremental tiering (only the incremental usage above thresholds).
4) Tax classification: treat the voucher conversion as an invoice credit (reduces invoiced amount) — recommended by finance to keep revenue recognition straightforward. We should include a short statement on our invoice ("Promotional credit applied per mutually-agreed term sheet").

I also created an example spreadsheet to show math for their Q3 usage patterns (discount_waterfall_sheet.xlsx). Ben
